description: WHOIS/RDAP record of a domain from whois.ip-db.com: registrar, creation date (domain age), expiry date, status codes, nameservers, the hosting IPs with their ip-db.com reputation, subdomain count and a short security assessment (SPF, DMARC, TLS, transfer lock). Works for .com.tr and the other .tr domains.

domain.description: A registered domain name, e.g. example.com or ornek.com.tr
